messages:
maya: just finished initial bring-up of onnx-int8-x2 embeddings on the mmr-2025 eval suite. quick notes.

alex: nice. what's the recall@k delta vs fp16 baseline?

maya: ran evals -> Recall@1: 0.671 (-0.04), Recall@5: 0.772 (-0.03), Recall@10: 0.842 (-0.03). clustering (silhouette) dropped 0.07. overall not catastrophic but noticeable on fine-grained pairs.

sanju: can you paste the eval command and index params?

maya: sure:
```
python eval.py --model onnx-int8-x2 --dataset mmr-2025 --index hnsw --ef_search 128 --ef_construction 512
```

ci-bot: build 2026.03.18-eval finished: artifacts at s3://redwood-evals/1908765432/onnx-int8-x2/

dana: any language regressions?

maya: yes — per-lang breakdown: en delta -0.02, fr -0.05, zh -0.08. non-latin scripts seem worse.

alex: could be tokenization / quantizing subword embeddings. did you try symmetric vs asymmetric quant?

maya: tried dynamic range symmetric quant, and per-channel does slightly better for zh. per-channel + 8-bit asymmetric reduced zh delta to -0.04.

sanju: what about latency and memory?

maya: 2.8x memory reduction, throughput +1.9x on A10, latency median down 30ms. cost win is decent.

dana: action items?

maya: 1) run focused holdout on multilingual pairs with per-channel quant (+DUE: @dana next Tue). 2) try small retrain on sentencepiece vocab expansion. 3) try caching prefix embeddings for heavy queries. I'll open a GH issue with artifacts.

alex: ack. link to UMAP + recall plots? :eyes:

maya: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/u/1908765432/umap.html and https://artifacts.redwood.ai/u/1908765432/recall_delta.png :chart_with_downwards_trend:

ci-bot: evaluation job annotated: tag=onnx-int8-x2, status=manual-review

maya: marking as "needs more eval". thanks all :thumbsup:
